title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Allergan Aesthetics
description:
The Lead Site Reliability Engineer will continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve critical technical problems for Allergan Aesthetics. You will be a hands-on technical leader driving reliability, availability, and operational excellence for large-scale public-facing software. As part of the Cloud Platform team, you will own how we measure, protect, and improve production reliability - championing SRE practices, building resilience into our platform, and ensuring our services meet the availability and performance standards our customers expect. You will provide technical thought leadership, mentor engineers across the organization, and turn small ideas into high-fidelity technical game plans that achieve both reliability and business goals.
Reliability Engineering:

• Define and champion SLO/SLI frameworks and error budget-based decision making to drive prioritization between reliability and feature work.

• Own observability strategy across services - metrics, logs, traces, and alerting - ensuring signals are actionable and tied to user impact.

• Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience/chaos testing for critical public-facing services.

• Establish production readiness reviews and partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.

• Identify and eliminate toil through automation, self-healing systems, and improved observability.

• Gather and analyze metrics from operating systems and applications to drive performance tuning and fault finding.

• Contribute reliability improvements to the platform through infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes configuration, working within Cloud Platform team standards.

Incident Management & Response:

• Own and evolve the incident response process, including severity definitions, escalation paths, and postmortem practice.

• Participate in on-call rotations and provide hands-on support during incidents with appropriate urgency.

• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application issues, driving blameless root cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion.

Standards & Architecture:

• Champion reliability, scalability, and security standards across AA Tech services and the AA Tech product platform.

• Partner and inform strategic architecture decisions for new services and major platform changes for reliability risks (failure modes, redundancy, scaling limits, alerting) before launch as part of Cloud Platform design reviews.

• Define and maintain reliability standards (e.g., SLO coverage, alerting, runbooks, backup and recovery requirements) and track how services meet them

• Stay current with the latest trends in site/service reliability practices and tooling. Identify proven technologies and solutions for emerging challenges.

Technical Mentorship:

• Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior-level DevOps and Software Engineers utilizing proven design patterns and experience building large-scale public-facing software.

• Foster a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the engineering organization.

• Provide technical thought leadership to implement strategic architecture, systems, and projects on the roadmap.

• Proven track record running SLO/error budget programs and incident management for large-scale production systems.

• Deep experience with observability platforms (e.g., Datadog) and alert design.

• Working proficiency with Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS; comfortable reading, reviewing, and contributing infrastructure code.

• Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and tooling.

Preferred:

• Hands-on experience using or building agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP-based integrations) to automate engineering or operational workflows, with appropriate guardrails and human oversight.
Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay

title: Senior Product Information Specialist
SAP ChaRM Specialist
description:
This is a remote position.
We are looking for a hands-on SAP Operations / ALM specialist to lead and operate change control, test management and solution documentation activities across SAP landscapes. This is not a generic SolMan consultant role - the candidate must have deep, demonstrable experience with ChaRM, Test Workbench and maintaining solution documentation in SAP Solution Manager. The role will support release cycles, ensure quality gates are met and keep system documentation accurate and audit-ready. Main Responsibilities

• Operate and govern ChaRM processes: ticket lifecycle, transport orchestration, approvals, emergency fixes and release management.

• Configure and operate Change Request Management workflows (including CTS+, transport routes and landscape handling).

• Manage and run Test Workbench: design test plans, create and maintain test cases, execute test runs, manage test cycles and report results.

• Maintain and author solution documentation: technical and functional documentation in Solution Documentation, building and updating requirements-to-implementation traceability.

• Coordinate with development, basis, DBA and infrastructure teams to ensure transports are applied safely and rollbacks are planned.

• Support release and cutover activities, drive quality gates and readiness checks.

• Implement and improve ALM processes and automation where possible (integration with CI/CD, automated test triggers, test data management).

• Produce test and release artefacts for audits and compliance (SOX, regulatory as required).

• Troubleshoot ChaRM/Test Workbench issues, drive root-cause analysis and preventative measures.

• Train and coach application teams and support staff on ChaRM and Test Workbench best practices.

Requirements

• Minimum 4-6 years hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager (7.1 / 7.2) in production environments.

• Proven deep experience operating ChaRM / Change Request Management and transport management (CTS/CTS+).

• Strong knowledge of Test Workbench: test plan creation, test case management, test execution and results reporting.

• Practical experience with Solution Documentation: creating process maps, building requirement links and maintaining implementation documentation.

• Good understanding of SAP landscape topologies and transport routes across DEV / QA / PROD.

• Experience supporting SAP releases and cutovers; familiarity with emergency transport handling.

• Basic knowledge of ABAP or ability to read transport logs and coordinate with developers.

• Experience with integration between Solution Manager and ALM/CI tools (Jira, Git, Jenkins) is a plus.

• Familiar with audit/compliance needs: ability to prepare artefacts and evidence for audits.

• Solid problem-solving skills and demonstrable track record of reducing rework and failed transports.

Behavioural / soft skills

• Clear, structured communicator able to work with technical teams and business stakeholders.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail; disciplined about runbooks and documentation.

• Proactive, takes ownership of incidents and release issues.

• Comfortable working in 24/7-support environments and participating in on-call rotations if required.

• English fluency; local language as required by the assignment.

Nice to have

• Experience with Focused Build / Focused Run.

• Knowledge of automated testing tools integrated with Solution Manager (eCATT, CBTA, or third-party test automation).

• Exposure to cloud-hosted SAP landscapes (HANA, S/4HANA migrations).

• Experience with SAP Transport Management Tooling and third-party transport orchestration.

Benefits

• Fully remote work model

• Mentorship - work closely with experienced engineers in a high-impact environment

• International project - cybersecurity domain with real-world impact​

title: Customer Care Specialist (s němčinou)
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.

Jako Customer Care Specialist budeš v první linii téhle zkušenosti. Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

Co od tebe potřebujeme

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role

- Němčina je nutnost (pokročilá úroveň) - psaná i mluvená

- Čeština/slovenština je nutnost

- Angličtina je výhodou / silným plusem - psaná i mluvená

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

Co z toho budeš mít

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce? Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

title: L1 SOC ANALYST
description:
About The Role
KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.
This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.
What You Will Do

• Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.

• Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.

• Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.

• Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.

• Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.

• Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.

• Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.

• Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.

• Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For
Required

• 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.

• Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.

• Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.

• Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.

• Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.

• The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

• Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.

• Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.

• CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.

• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

• Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

• Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG .

• A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.

• A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.

• Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.

• European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

Professional Competencies
Collaborative Spirit | Results Above All | Innovation as a Habit | Creative Freedom | Financial Prudence | Eternal Learner | Daring Adventures | Open Feedback | Integrity in Action | Embrace Change | Accountability

At the scale we build, our campuses are typically served by dedicated high-voltage substations and a medium-voltage distribution network that may also integrate on-site generation and battery energy storage - and the protection, control, and automation layer is what keeps all of it selective, coordinated, and observable.

 

As a Data Center Substation, Protection & Automation Engineer, you'll own the protection and automation architecture across Anthropic's US portfolio - from the utility point of interconnection (POI) through the HV/MV substation, the MV distribution loop, and down into LV switchgear. You'll develop and maintain our protection philosophy and reference relay settings, run and review the short-circuit, coordination, and arc-flash studies that underpin them, design the substation automation and SCADA architecture, and define how relays and meters integrate into the electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) - giving operators real-time visibility and sequence-of-events data when something trips. You'll also be our technical lead on the protection side of utility interconnection - working relay settings, transfer-trip, and ride-through requirements with transmission owners and ISOs/RTOs.

 

Protection engineering and substation automation are the core of this role; substation physical design is a strong plus but not a prerequisite - we'd like to hear from protection and P&C engineers who have spent their careers on relays, schemes, and studies even if they haven't owned a substation general arrangement. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, our build partners' A/E firms, relay and switchgear vendors, and utility protection groups. Expect roughly 20-35% travel for witnessing factory acceptance and relay testing, and supporting site energization and commissioning.

Specify protective relays and develop relay settings for transformer, feeder, bus, generator, motor, and arc-flash protection applications, working across major platforms (e.g., SEL, GE Multilin, ABB, Siemens, Schneider)

title: Staff Safety Engineer, Safety Metrics and Benchmarking
locationText: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States; Remote U.S.
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Staff Safety Engineer to lead the definition, development, and operationalization of safety metrics and benchmarking methodologies for Level 4 autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi deployment.

In this role, you will establish quantitative frameworks to measure AV safety performance across on-road testing, simulation, and external benchmarks. You will develop statistically rigorous methodologies for risk estimation, counterfactual modeling, near-miss tracking, and collision severity assessment to guide deployment and software release decisions.

Partnering across Safety Engineering, Systems Readiness & Performance, Autonomy, Data Science, and Fleet Operations, you will translate complex data into actionable metrics, governance frameworks, and executive evidence to ensure safe driverless commercial launch.

Key Responsibilities:

Safety Metrics Development:

• Define, standardize, and maintain core AV safety performance indicators (SPIs), including vehicle collisions, near-misses, safety-critical interventions, traffic compliance, and surrogate safety metrics

• Establish standardized metric definitions, exposure denominators (e.g., VMT), data quality requirements, automated calculation pipelines, and change-management governance for safety metrics.

• Develop leading and lagging indicators to monitor safety performance across software releases, operational design domains (ODDs), and structured scenario taxonomies.

• Develop quantitative benchmarking frameworks comparing AV safety performance against human-driving baselines, counterfactual models, public datasets (e.g., SHRP2, NASS-GES), and regulatory disclosures.

• Evaluate comparability across operators and human drivers, accounting for exposure normalization, operating conditions, event severity levels, and reporting differences.

• Establish scenario-based and exposure-normalized targets that provide meaningful safety criteria and align with partner/external readiness expectations.

• Clearly communicate benchmarking assumptions, limitations, and statistical uncertainty.

• Apply statistical inference, uncertainty quantification, Bayesian methods, and risk modeling to evaluate AV behavior and scenario-level performance.

• Develop methods to analyze rare and high-severity events, establishing confidence intervals, sample-size requirements, and statistical evidence thresholds for release decisions.

• Build collision severity and injury-risk models to evaluate impact dynamics, delta-V, and potential harm mitigation.

• Connect quantitative findings to engineering investigations, safety mitigations, and release readiness assessments.

Technical Leadership:

• Provide technical leadership and cross-functional alignment across Safety Case, Systems Engineering, Simulation, Data Science, and Policy teams.

• Lead the establishment of change management procedures and governance for approval and iteration of safety metrics and benchmarking targets.

• Communicate technical evidence, uncertainty, and safety readiness assessments effectively to internal executives, key partner stakeholders, and regulatory bodies.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical field.

• 8+ years of experience in safety engineering, autonomous driving evaluation, statistical modeling, simulation-based validation, or AV risk assessment.

• Proven track record of defining quantitative safety metrics, SPIs, surrogate safety measures, and human benchmark models.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience analyzing large-scale operational or safety-related datasets.

• Strong expertise in statistical inference, rare-event analysis, counterfactual modeling, risk quantification, and release-readiness evaluation.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives and communicate complex findings clearly.

The OpenTable for Restaurants (OT4R) platform connects hospitality partners worldwide to a network of over 25 million diners. In this role, you will build and evolve the mission-critical native iOS application that enables restaurant hosts, servers, managers, and owners to orchestrate shifts, manage table inventory, and scale their operations. You will tackle complex technical challenges ranging from high-performance local data synchronization to designing intuitive, high-density user interfaces. Collaborating closely with engineers, product managers, and designers, you will translate open-ended product goals into elegant, production-grade mobile experiences.

Responsibilities

• Architect, build, and ship robust, production-quality native iOS features that power day-to-day restaurant floor operations.

• Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to translate open-ended problem statements into validated technical requirements and UX implementations.

• Deconstruct multi-month engineering initiatives into phased, value-driven milestones, driving technical execution from concept through launch.

• Champion high software quality standards by writing comprehensive automated test suites, leading architecture reviews, and refining CI/CD pipelines.

• Leverage advanced iOS profiling and debugging tools to triage support escalations, resolve runtime anomalies, and optimize client performance.

• Mentor peer engineers, foster inclusive code review practices, and responsibly integrate modern AI-assisted workflows into day-to-day development.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of building and shipping native iOS applications using Swift in production.

• Deep technical expertise across modern iOS development frameworks, including SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency (Async/Await), Combine, and Core Data.

• Extensive hands-on experience debugging and profiling memory, latency, and layout performance using Instruments, LLDB, and standard iOS toolchains.

• Proven experience writing scalable, maintainable mobile code with automated unit and integration test coverage.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills with a track record of clearly evaluating and explaining technical trade-offs to product and design partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing complex B2B mobile applications characterized by high information density, dense domain logic, and state management challenges.

• Track record leading iOS release management lifecycles, including App Store submission, staged rollouts, feature flag management, and regression triage.

• Demonstrated background architecting foundational mobile layers, including networking protocols, offline caching, modular architectures, or design system components.

• Familiarity incorporating AI-assisted developer tools responsibly to accelerate code delivery, testing, and incident investigation.

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. We're hiring a senior attorney to partner with our GTM team on enterprise deals as Baseten moves upmarket. You'll work with Sales, Security, Finance, Marketing, Eng and Product on our largest and most complex customer deals across large enterprise, regulated industries and AI-native companies.

At Baseten, commercial and product are the same thing. What we sell is inference: compute, orchestration, deployment, and optimization delivered as the production backbone for our customers' products. Closing a deal here means understanding how our product works (model deployment, data flows, multi-cloud routing, and latency and throughput) and the novel legal issues it raises. This is a role for a commercially minded product lawyer who wants to sit at that intersection.

- Track record negotiating complex agreements with large enterprises and regulated customers across healthcare, life sciences, financial services, retail and digital, and AI-native companies

title: QA Automation Lead

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

The QA Automation Leads are part of a leadership team and they work closely with QA Leads and Staff Engineers to enable Development Engineers to test the code that they produce.

The QA Automation Leads will be an authority on test data creation, test tools, and test automation best practice. They will coach Engineers through test automation, provision tools, and automate controls to ensure the quality of code delivered to client-facing teams and clients.

They will work with the Quality Enablement Team to embed automation frameworks, as well as automation that will audit AI generated code and tests. They will be the conduit between Engineering teams using these tools and the Enablement Team.

The QA Automation Leads will support QA professionals in the Forward Deployed Engineering Teams in the creation and validation of End to End tests that involve their domains.

 

- Coach and enable development engineers to write automated tests at service and domain level, and to test their own products and solutions.

- Partner with QA and development engineers in Forward Deployed Engineering teams to define and implement automated handovers between teams, and support their end-to-end testing.

- Implement innovative automation of testing, defect management and release processes for Global Product Teams, using AI where it adds value.

- Work with the Enablement Team to build intelligent automated testing solutions (such as testing the tests) and roll them out.

- Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine and scale internal testing tools and frameworks, and build AI-driven tools that remove bottlenecks in code and architecture and speed up test-and-deploy cycles.

- Lead by example as a technical leader: champion best practice in test automation, AI code validation and agent tooling, write clean, testable code, perform code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.

What you’ll bring

- Experience building, maintaining and enhancing test automation frameworks, using tools and languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright or Cypress.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, API design, data structures) in Python, TypeScript or similar, with experience automating tests using APIs.

- Knowledge of improving test data management, users and scenarios for ease of testing, and of working with developers to review automated unit and integration tests.

- Previous management experience, leading and coaching engineers across test cases

- A solid understanding of the SDLC, Agile methology and QA process.

- Experience using AI tools, such as LLM-based coding assistants and agent frameworks, as part of a pipeline, along with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge), since traditional pass/fail assertions

title: Senior iOS Engineer

description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Stores Intelligence organization is building the operating system for brick-and-mortar grocery. As a Senior iOS Engineer on the In-Store Mode team, you will build the mobile experience that helps people shop in physical grocery stores. Customers plan the trip at home, then use the same app in the aisle to find items, discover deals, and use their loyalty rewards.

What makes the engineering interesting:

• One experience, many apps: In-Store Mode runs inside many grocers' branded apps and blends native iOS with web, so you'll design for flexibility, consistency, and a clear boundary between the two.

• The physical world is challenging: The same feature has to work in a small neighborhood market and a large wholesale store, with very different layouts, assortments, and shopping habits, while powering in-store navigation and discovery.

About the Job

• Lead iOS projects end to end, from technical design and rollout strategy through production operations and debugging.

• Shape product requirements by bringing a technical perspective and making trade-offs between scope, quality, and timeline.

• Build and maintain integrations between native iOS code and web content.

• Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools to boost your own and the team's productivity, and suggest improvements to how the team builds.

• Collaborate with engineers, designers, data scientists, and PMs across teams to align goals and deliver cross-functional outcomes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in mobile development, software engineering, or related experience

• Strong experience with iOS fundamentals, including Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency or Combine

• Experience with networking protocols (RPC, REST API, WebSockets)

• Experience designing for performance, observability, and reliability in production mobile apps, including profiling and monitoring

• Strong testing discipline, including unit tests for the code you write

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building consumer apps in retail, e-commerce, or marketplace settings

• Experience building configurable or white-label apps, or shared components used across multiple apps

• Experience building mobile apps that stay resilient with limited or unreliable connectivity

• Experience running experiments and A/B tests, and using the results to guide product decisions

• Experience with Apple frameworks such as Core Location and push notifications

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows
